name: Sadr Logistics Company
summary: Sadr Logistics Company, established in 1994 in Buraydah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and previously known as Al Samaani Factory For Metal Industries Company, specializes in delivering comprehensive storage and material handling solutions. The company offers a wide array of products, including various types of pallets (wooden, plastic, and steel), and an extensive range of racking systems such as pallet, drive-in, cantilever, VNA, radio shuttle, and cladding racks, along with shelving units and mezzanines. Beyond core storage, they provide solutions for supermarkets (gondola shelving, shopping carts) and offices (mobile shelves, carousels, lockers), alongside essential handling equipment like forklifts, hand pallets, roll containers, and conveyors. Sadr Logistics also offers warehousing services and infrastructure, encompassing dock levelers, fixed elevators, ramps, fire fighting equipment, and epoxy flooring systems, in addition to advanced warehousing automation solutions. The company's manufacturing expertise extends to prefabricated steel structures, furniture, and the forging, pressing, casting, and rolling of metal products. Its operations are organized into Steel, Wood, Logistics, and Other segments.
